lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: The posterior region relative to the fifth gill slit exhibits four primary horizontal tiers of high-luminance circular blobs. The centroids are arranged in a semi-regular grid, with approximately eight distinct maxima visible in the median row before the pattern is obscured by caustic surface reflections.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting the horizontal rows of blobs at near-90-degree angles, creating a characteristic checkerboard grid where the blobs serve as primary anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal carina is clearly visible running from the mid-flank toward the caudal peduncle, showing a distinct light-to-shadow gradient with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and a low-intensity shadow immediately below.
